title: The Arban trumpet method
summary: Charlie DeVoy says Thomas studied the Arban method; Thomas recalls the thick, hard book.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers

blocks.x: No. Did you study the Auburn Method? Auburn? No.
No. I got a book man but that was thick man.
Charlie DeVoy told me you studied the Auburn Method. That must be the one you taught me about.
Yeah. Yeah. That was thick book.
So you've been, Charlie said you've been all the way through it. That's about as hard a trumpet method you're going to find.
